batch.offline_policy: Official training roster dates are assumed complete at local end of day. No feed telemetry is available. Serving requires an externally declared closed-through watermark.

alerts.selection_rule: Select the largest candidate within the ordinary-day burden limit for each model. Disable binary alerting if no candidate meets the limit. Raw scores remain available.

reference.calibration: expanding prior-only from known training seed batches
reference.update_rule: Exclude all fresh observations by default. A future reviewed-mode refresh requires explicit dated clearance of complete batches for each merchant-day. Quarantine affected dates pending review.

episodes.truth_grouping: Consecutive labelled dates with the same merchant and anomaly type
episodes.matching: One-to-one on same merchant with actual alert dates overlapping positive dates. Maximize the match count, then prefer greater overlap and smaller first-alert delay. No symptom-to-label mapping or timing tolerance.
